jobs.description_text:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

Data is at the heart of Lyft’s products and decision-making. You will leverage data and rigorous, analytical thinking to shape our products and make business decisions. This will involve performing rigorous product deep dives, identifying opportunities for product enhancements, and measuring the impact of product changes.

The Airports team, within the Driver organization, focuses on the airport marketplace and the unique products designed for this use case. Airports are one of the most important, impactful, and complex parts of Lyft’s Rideshare business, as they are a key part of both the rider and driver Lyft experience and have unique dynamics. As an Analytics Lead on the Airport team, you will collaborate with our team of engineers, product managers, and designers to conduct thorough data deep dives on airport performance, challenge our current strategy, and recommend enhancements to facilitate market growth.

The ideal candidate can apply strong business acumen to propose product and marketplace changes, and is comfortable working with a highly cross functional team. In this role, you will help us tackle problems such as:

  • How should we determine pricing and earnings for airport rides? 
  • Who are our current airport drivers and what segment can we focus on to

jobs.description_text:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

Lyft Urban Solutions (LUS) creates bikeshare programs that riders love, cities need, and operators value. We design, build and support the bikes and stations technology behind bikeshare programs in cities around the world, including Bixi. Our Montreal team sits at the heart of that work, bringing together engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, operations, marketing and commercial teams under one roof.

You are expected to conduct and lead internationally competitive research in AI-driven semantic analysis and automated reasoning-flow modeling, with applications to educational materials, scientific documents, and research authoring. You are expected to contribute to the development of internationally visible, foundational research in AI-driven semantic structure extraction, automated reasoning-flow modeling, and adaptive content generation. jobs.title: Working Student - Talent Acquisition
jobs.description_text:
En bref

Vous avez envie de contribuer à la révolution des supermarchés ? Chez Picnic, vous avez l’opportunité de rejoindre une jeune équipe créative et bouillonnante, dans une culture start-up, où tout ce que vous faites compte. Grâce à une approche basée sur les données (data-driven) et un service unique, Picnic se bat pour faire des courses quelque chose de simple, drôle et accessible à tous. En outre, nous travaillons dans la perspective d’un avenir plus durable en utilisant des technologies de pointe et en exploitant une flotte de véhicules de livraison 100 % électriques.

En 2021, Picnic a levé 600 millions d’euros auprès de la Fondation Bill & Melinda Gates afin de se développer en Europe. Après avoir lancé avec succès les opérations en Allemagne et dans le Nord de la France, nous poursuivons maintenant notre expansion en France en nous développant notamment en région parisienne.

jobs.title: UX Researcher - Dutch speaking
jobs.description_text:
In a nutshell 

As our UX researcher, you will work collaboratively with Data Analysts, Product Owners, and Designers to develop the full user experience of Picnic’s products. With an open personality, you’re able to empathize with end-users on a weekly basis, whether that’s by guiding users through prototypes or investigating a new topic.

Half of the week, you initiate, plan and execute hands-on research activities. The other half is used to observe and analyse user behaviour and communicate those insights effectively to various teams and stakeholders. You experiment with research approaches to answer important questions. How can we make in-app customer service more accessible?  How do customers decide what to eat?  How can we make delivering our groceries safer for our runners? Every week presents new challenges to explore, frame and evaluate. Understanding both the big picture and the details, you examine insights from unique angles to bring a deeper understanding of customer experience and provide testable hypotheses.
